stem: During a school science exhibition, Meera builds a model of the Solar System. Her teacher asks why Earth, unlike planets much closer to or much farther from the Sun, can support life. Which property of Earth's position around the Sun makes life possible?

options.text: Earth is the largest planet, so it can hold more water.
Earth is at a distance where the temperature allows water to exist as a liquid.
Earth is the fastest-moving planet, so its water never freezes.
Earth is blue in colour, so sunlight is absorbed better.

teacher.key_rationale: Earth's orbital distance keeps surface temperatures in a range where water stays liquid, and liquid water is essential for habitability; B states this relationship. A, C and D are scientifically incorrect distractors.
